FOUNDER.NAME: Soufiane Rafique
FOUNDER.QUOTE: We built X10ECOM because we saw how much potential the GCC market holds — and how few tools were built specifically for it. Our mission is to remove every barrier between ambitious brands and the region's fastest-growing consumers.
FOUNDER.BIO: With over 10 years of experience in e-commerce and international logistics, Soufiane created X10ECOM to give brands a true end-to-end partner in the GCC & MENA region — from product sourcing to last-mile delivery.
